name: @wasm-gaming/blastem-wasm
description: BlastEm (Sega Mega Drive / Genesis emulator) compiled to WebAssembly, with a self-contained JS SDK implementing the wasm-gaming engine contract.
comment:scripts: Build logic lives in the Makefile, not here (make build / build-sdk / build-wasm / preview).
comment:dependencies: engine-specs is the one wasm-gaming package an engine depends on. Its runtime is also copied into dist/blastem/ and imported relatively, so the built SDK loads without a bundler or an import map; the dependency carries the types.
